messages:
anya: quick heads-up 0 — customer success and sales asked for a 'First Month Guarantee' idea: guaranteed elevated throughput + explicit billing visibility for the first 30 days to reduce churn. want to decide shape (promo SKU vs policy), safety caps, and launch criteria.

mike: runtime perspective: we can model as an ephemeral quota object (start_ts + expiry_ts + profile). prefer rolling 30-day window so customers don't hit billing-cycle confusion. key: enforce per-route caps and a soft-throttle to prevent queueing.

jordan: came from 3 pilot customers — they want predictable headroom for product launch days (not continuous high traffic). they explicitly requested ability to opt out and a visible invoice line.

sylvia: accounting/legal prefer a promo SKU for auditability. Proposal label: "First Month Guarantee (promo)" with invoice_meta.promo_code=FMG_30. Clause snippet: "A promotional throughput uplift for 30 days from activation; automatically expires and is provided at no additional charge to eligible accounts."

lee: ops concern: if many accounts launch same week, we could overload nodes. suggest global concurrent promo cap and a per-region throttle. add metric: promo_concurrent_count. Also recommend a concurrency circuit: if promo_concurrent_count > threshold then auto-set new signups to manual enablement.

mike: implementation plan: feature-flag rollout, per-account expiry, admin Console toggle default ON for self-serve, opt-out via Console/support. add audit log for manual extensions and sales-granted activations. extension flow: one-time manual +15 days max.

anya: launch criteria proposal: (1) telemetry: p95 delta < 1.8x and no queue depth increase > 20% in 24h canary; (2) error rate delta < 3%; (3) Console toggle + admin API + audit logs in place; (4) invoice sample + T&Cs approved; (5) pilot comms ready.

sylvia: will draft T&Cs snippet + sample invoice rows. also recommend promo appears as "Promotional: First Month Guarantee" to avoid surprise. will push to #legal for quick sign-off.

jordan: I'll recruit 5 pilot customers (2 startups, 2 mid-market, 1 internal). will get opt-in consent and test comms language. Sales requested a bill-preview UI so customers see promo line before launch.

lee: add runtime telemetry and alerts: promo_request_ratio, p95_latency_delta_promo, promo_extension_count, promo_node_pressure. set automated rollback if p95 delta > 2x or GPU util > 85% sustained.

mike: agree. will add token-bucket soft-limiter per-route and enforce a hard cap at account level. Ops-bot: schedule canary build "fmg-v1" to 3% tomorrow 08:00 UTC.

ops-bot: deploy-candidate: "fmg-v1" created. canary to 3% at 08:00 UTC. monitoring hooks enabled.

anya: Decision recap: build promo SKU "First Month Guarantee (promo)", rolling 30-day window, Console toggle default ON for self-serve, manual one-time +15 day extension via Sales (audited), global concurrent guard, rollout behind feature flag with telemetry and rollback thresholds. Action items: Mike: API + rate-limiter + canary; Sylvia: invoice + T&Cs; Jordan: pilot recruitment + comms + bill-preview UX ask; Lee: telemetry + cluster guard; Anya: update PRD and acceptance criteria.

mike: noted. will post canary dashboard link when live.

sylvia: draft clause posted to #legal for review.

jordan: 2 pilot opt-ins confirmed. reaching out to 3 more.

anya: great work. reconvene after 24h canary results. :thumbsup:
